intermediate.name: Valico di Monte Carruozzo
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Valico di Monte Carruozzo (56.6 km)
Red Bull KM Sprint | Brusciano (174.6 km)

story: The longest stage of the Giro d’Italia featured a hard-fought battle for the early break before two riders went clear. A heavy crash in the rain, with former Giro winner Hindley among the worst affected, led to a neutralisation and no time gaps or bonuses at the finish. After racing resumed, the escapees were caught inside the final three kilometres before Groves won the sprint.
